items.meta_description: Download VpnHood! CLIENT for Android, iOS, Windows, or Linux. It has no built-in VPN servers — you need an access key from whoever runs the server.
items.page_desc: Fast, secure, and reliable VPN solution powered by VpnHood! ENGINE, which is open-source and the first VPN developed fully with the .NET platform.
items.notice_desc: VpnHood! CLIENT does not include any VPN servers of its own, so it cannot connect to anything on its own. You need an access key, also called a server key, from whoever runs the server — paste it into the app once and you are connected.
items.direct_link_note: It's best to download with the direct link only when you don't have access to Google Play.
items.android_web_note: The version from the direct link does not use Google Play.
items.android_arm64_desc: For most phones. The smaller download.
items.android_universal_desc: For old phones and many Android TVs.
items.linux_distros_note: Supports Ubuntu 22.04 and later (including Kubuntu and Lubuntu), Debian 13 and Arch Linux; other distributions with systemd should also work.
